question: Fill in the blank:The Tippani dance involves rhythmic floor pounding using ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**bamboo poles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **The Tippani Dance** is a traditional folk dance form originating from the **state of Gujarat, India**. It is performed primarily by women in rural areas.
 
• The dance involves the use of **bamboo poles**, which are utilized for rhythmic pounding on the floor. These bamboo poles are an integral part of the dance performance.
 
• The rhythmic pounding of the bamboo poles is symbolic of the traditional methods of working, particularly activities related to agriculture and household chores.
 
• The performance is accompanied by **folk music and singing**, which adds to the vibrancy of the dance. The songs often narrate tales of rural life, festivities, and the cultural heritage of Gujarat.
 
• The Tippani dance is usually performed during **festive occasions** or celebrations like weddings, harvest festivals, or community gatherings, showcasing the rich cultural traditions of the region.
